preparation.title: A few minutes before you enter
lines: Enter calmly. Your slot is protected.
Keep moving with your batch, and do not stop in the corridors.
Greet the Prophet ﷺ and his two companions, Abu Bakr and Umar, in a low voice.
Time inside the Rawdah is limited for everyone; keep your prayer brief and heartfelt.
No photography inside. Phone in the pocket.
preparation.greeting_ar: السلام عليك يا رسول الله ورحمة الله وبركاته. السلام عليك يا أبا بكر الصديق. السلام عليك يا عمر بن الخطاب.
preparation.greeting: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon you, O Abu Bakr al-Siddiq. Peace be upon you, O Umar ibn al-Khattab.
preparation.source: From the Authority's published guidance on visiting the Rawdah; wording pending Authority review.

journey.t24: Your visit to the Rawdah is tomorrow at {slot}. Your gate: {gate}. Your gathering point: {point}. Leave the {hotel_area} area at about {depart} (about {walk_min} minutes at an unhurried pace). Your slot is protected within your window; there is no need to hurry.
journey.t90: In about 90 minutes: your slot is at {slot}. Leave at {depart} for {gate}, then the gathering point {point}. Bring water and your permit, and walk gently.
journey.t30: In about 30 minutes: your slot is at {slot}. Please head now to the gathering point {point} at {gate}. At the sorting point your permit is read once; then you move with your batch.
journey.protected_note: Arrive within your window; if you are late, the supervisor will place you in the next batch.
